Name: FS - Fairy Wings
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack that comes with four standard pairs of fairy wings.

Choose your own Colour: One of these pairs is opaque (CYOC Opaque Fairy Wings) while the other is transparent (CYOC Transparent Fairy Wings). Both of these sets of wings comes in whatever colour you choose! Simply use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror Tool[/url] to select this accessory and its colour.

Prismatic: The prismatic wings come in opaque (Prismatic Opaque Fairy Wings) and transparent (Prismatic Transparent Fairy Wings). You won't be able to choose the colour this time though. 

EDIT: Thank you guys for getting me to one of the hot mods!

If you have any requests for this mod, leave a comment
